CustomField.description: When true, the formTemplate runtime does not apply Prefill Values to new Form Submissions, and the before-trigger does not auto-create a Prefill Template on insert. Use to disable template-level prefill while keeping URL parameter mapping and prefill Flows in play.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When enabled, new submissions skip all pre-fill, so neither the Pre-fill Template nor the Pre-fill Flow runs. Use it to force a completely blank form even when a pre-fill source is configured.
CustomField.label: Skip Prefill
